title: Chest panel: Terraria text buttons (Loot All, Deposit All, Quick Stack, Restock, Sort Items, Rename), favourites respected, close sound
player_outcome: An open chest sits under your inventory in teal slots, with Terraria's white text buttons that glow gold on hover: Loot All, Deposit All, Quick Stack, Restock, Sort Items and Rename. Renaming shows the chest's own name. The chest creaks shut when you walk away.
design:
New game/UI/Inventory/ChestPanel.cs, shown in the panel host.
- Title Label: CustomName ?? Def.DisplayName.
- A grid of 40 pooled slot views (10 columns, SlotKind.Chest) at 42 · SlotScale px.
- A right-hand VBox of UiTheme TextButtons (theme variation 'TextButton') calling Core InventoryOps and GameWorld ops. Core already marks chunks modified, so the UI MarkContainerModified duplication is dropped.

Rename: swap the title for a themed LineEdit. On focus set InputGate.TextEntry and open a Modal gate 'rename', so typing never moves the player. Enter commits through GameWorld.RenameContainer; Esc cancels.
Move the chest open/close logic out of InventoryScreen.cs into ChestPanel: OpenContainer, CloseContainer, the 6 m distance check.
Sounds: chest_open (existing), plus a new 'chest_close' recipe (creak(180)) in tools/audio/sfx_recipes.py, played on close.
files_modify: game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs — delegate container handling to ChestPanel
tests:
ui.cmds:
- `place wooden_chest 0 0 -3` / `interact 0 0 -3` / `assert ui.inventory == 1`.
- `give wood 30` / `chest deposit` / `assert inv.wood == 0`.
- `chest loot` / `assert inv.wood == 30`.
- `chest rename Loot` / `ui close` / `assert errors == 0`.
verification: Lavapipe screenshot with the chest open: teal slots under the grid, text buttons on the right, crafting column still visible
risks: The chest lid animation (critic) is art/object work, not included here.
